# Refract

> Scoped React state with selectors and rollback for TypeScript apps in React or the Next.js App Router. createContextState<State>() returns a Provider and hooks: components subscribe through selectors compared by value, update with partial objects or Immer drafts, read the latest state with a snapshot getter, and undo any single update with the revert function it returns. React 18 or 19, ES modules, Immer as the only dependency, 'use client' on every module.

Install with `npm i refract-state`. Inside an installed project these pages are at node_modules/refract-state/docs/ and match the installed version.

## For agents

- [Refract for coding agents](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/agents.md): the import, every factory member with its signature, rules and limits in one page

## Guides

- [Read with selectors](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/selectors.md): value comparison, purity rules
- [Update state](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/updates.md): partial objects, drafts, copying and freezing, snapshots in handlers
- [Optimistic updates with revert](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/rollback.md): what a revert restores
- [Seed and load data](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/data.md): initialState, resetting, loading flags
- [Feature hooks](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/feature-hooks.md): named read and action hooks
- [Scope, nesting and several stores](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/scopes.md): Provider placement and the missing-Provider fallback
- [Wrap a component with its Provider](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/wrap-components.md): withContextProvider, bindPropToState, StateSynchronizer
- [Post-flush callbacks](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/post-flush.md): derived data once per batch
- [Next.js App Router](https://github.com/khanglvm/refract/blob/main/docs/nextjs.md): server and client boundaries, seeding from the server, troubleshooting
